created_by: FlameLens data team, with an SI tool
si_use: An SI tool (Claude) found NASA's ACME overview on NTRS and wrote a script, which cuts each finding word for word from the paper's text. The SI tool chose the sentences. No value was generated. The team's six members have checked it. Versions 2 and 3 add curves and PMT gain settings: a script reads each test point's instrument log, thins it by a written rule and copies the photomultiplier values unchanged; the SI tool chose the channels from NASA's two documents.
summary: Flame Design: 5 results NASA states in words in its overview of the six ACME gas-flame experiments. Version 3: 121886 curve points (photomultiplier OH* and CH* currents) and 614 PMT gain settings for 307 test points.
